sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id ELSE NULL END) AS selling_store_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
